📺 Mr. D (2012–2018)

Mr. D follows Gerry Duncan, a confident but often clueless high school teacher working at the fictional Xavier Academy in Canada. Despite believing he is an excellent educator, Gerry frequently finds himself in hilarious situations caused by his questionable teaching methods, poor decisions, and constant attempts to impress his coworkers and students. As he navigates classroom challenges, school politics, awkward relationships, and unexpected responsibilities, his overconfidence regularly leads to embarrassing consequences. Surrounded by eccentric teachers, administrators, and students, Gerry struggles to balance his ambitions with the realities of working in education. Starring comedian Gerry Dee, Mr. D combines sarcastic humor, awkward encounters, and relatable workplace comedy while exploring friendship, responsibility, and the unpredictable experiences of school life.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Gerry Dee & Michael Volpe

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and other digital platforms for current streaming or purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Mr. D is a Canadian television series starring comedian Gerry Dee. The series follows the misadventures of an under-qualified schoolteacher named Gerry Duncan, nicknamed Mr. D. It debuted on the CBC on January 9, 2012, and concluded after eight seasons on December 19, 2018. On December 11, 2020, Mr. D became available for streaming in the United States on Amazon Prime Video.
